title: SSRF 与出站边界
implementation: internal/outbound: blocked-range classification (loopback, RFC1918/ULA private, link-local incl. 169.254 metadata, unspecified, multicast), DNS-answer validation (a hostname resolving into a blocked range is rejected, dual-stack answers must be fully clean), and per-hop URL validation (scheme, userinfo, host allowlist)
rssfetch: Boundary option - every redirect hop is revalidated, private IP literals and DNS bypass rejected when hardened; host allowlist supported per fetcher
torrentdownload: RejectPrivateIPs mode with injectable resolver covering direct downloads and redirect hops on top of the existing host allowlist and redirect revalidation
runtime: serve enables hardened mode by default; unhardened behavior preserved for local development and tests
